notes: FROZEN (agent=partial, daemon=incapable) — structurally n.a. for Copilot, not a defect. Copilot 1.0.77 subagents are IN-PROCESS: subagent.started/subagent.completed pair on toolCallId inside the PARENT's events.jsonl (live-captured in 3-1_foreground-subagent, agentId:null) and NO $COPILOT_HOME/session-state/<child>/ directory is ever created (parser.go:382-404 trackSubagent). irrlicht keys a Copilot session to that directory (agent.go:38-41, FilesUnderRoot + sessionIDFromPath), so there is no child SessionState, no parent_linked event and no subagent transcript. This scenario's object is a CHILD that OUTLIVES its parent and must be swept as an orphan; a delegation running inside the parent's turn has no independent existence to outlive anything, so the two hard acceptance bullets ('>= 1 child session(s) linked to a parent', '>= 1 subagent transcript(s)') have no producible input and the daemon's child-orphan machinery (pid_manager.go:1044-1071 reapStaleChild/onChildDeleted) receives nothing. Unlike codex (thread_spawn_edges) and kiro-cli (sidecar parent_session_id) there is NO adapter unblock path: the child entity does not exist anywhere to be read. The residual single-session SIGKILL+sweep is already recorded by 1-2_session-end (daemon=full, sigkill mid-turn), so a recording here would duplicate 1-2 while dropping both bullets that make 3.4 distinct. NOT a driver gap: driver-interactive.sh:128 already elicits sigkill and restart. No lifecycle phases are asserted; re-assess only if a future Copilot CLI gives subagents their own on-disk session record.
